headline: Fresh Flips Stir Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, FishermansRowHex has erupted anew: eight events were logged in the latest two hours and 32 across the day, with Black Well and Eidolo each recording 12; its holdings stand at seven Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral base. WeatheredExpanseHex remains the broadest furnace, reaching 39 daily events, four in the latest two hours, and a divided map of four Warden, three Colonial, and two neutral bases as casualty and enlistment rates accelerate. CallahansPassage has added two fresh events at Crumbling Post, while its nine Warden bases and one neutral position sit amid very heavy, accelerating losses on both sides. StlicanShelf is quieter at the instant, but its 28 daily events and eight-Warden, one-Colonial split preserve a live contest. Stonecradle has recorded 12 daily events and remains divided five Warden to four Colonial, with enlistments accelerating despite no fresh two-hour movement. DeadLands shows six daily events at Callahan's Gate, though the latest action is older and the immediate front is quiet. No victor is declared.
